ارتعفا (form VIII)
# اِرْتَعَفَا (irtaʕafā) /ir.ta.ʕa.faː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اُرْتُعِفَا (urtuʕifā) /ur.tu.ʕi.faː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
# اِرْتَعِفَا (irtaʕifā) /ir.ta.ʕi.faː/: second-person dual imperative of اِرْتَعَفَ (irtaʕafa)
